command_or_fixture: Independent live MCP code_read inspection, intent-to-AC map and readiness-safe counterexample review.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: A required intent has no AC, staged reading requires prior explanatory context, or a separate automatic repair is permitted after verification.
expected: All intended behavioral outcomes have finite falsifiable evaluation obligations; protocol order and upgrade ownership remain coherent.
known_bad_detection_method: Readiness-safe semantic counterexample: refuted the claim that existing review already guarantees uncoached reconstruction. Current review line 5 gives the full draft, brief and sources before line 7 asks to read the opening alone. Also rejected a hypothetical second automatic repair after verification against current line 26 and planned Requirement 5/AC-4. These are plan/source checks, not executed candidate behavior.
limitations: Readiness review only; no authoring trial, reconciliation run or product behavior executed. QA and architecture share one fresh worker context, independent of implementation; actual model identity unverified. Semantic expectations remain vulnerable to shared model/framing. Missing product-strategy/domain role files were checked against the role inventory; generic responsibilities come from Envision review table. Setup inputs changed advisory observed; direct live reads used, no environment repair.
observed: AC-2 covers actual early correction and capability-dependent roadmap changes; AC-3 covers uncoached reconstruction and meaning repair; AC-4 covers settled choice/no-interview/unavailable-review/post-verification stop. AC-1 guards coherent ownership and AC-5 guards delivery preservation. Existing review full-context-first order is the concrete gap Requirement 4 must replace. One repair remains owned by review companion. No readiness blocker found.
proposition: The admitted requirements and ACs establish the intended early correction, dependent-roadmap propagation and uncoached comprehension check without changing authority or multiplying repair rounds.
public_path: Admitted 226i1 plan and 228dy Objective; canonical Envision core/review/delivery instructions; seed160 changed-family reconciliation boundary.
safety_and_authorization: Read-only authorized readiness assessment; only disposable report written. No source, plan, ledger, actual vision or environment mutation.

command_or_fixture: Read retained author1/2/3, frozen 02/03, reader1/2, review-draft, mutation-provenance, repaired revision and verification, branchB4; independently compare semantics. Rehash 51 evaluation and 150 delivery artifact blobs against byte count/SHA256 and eight current GO source hashes. Targeted STANDARD isolated primer then docs-contract seat and red-team closing.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: Actual operator correction fails to change statement/path, evidence fails to change prerequisites, reconstruction receives expected meaning beforehand, a new automatic repair is added, or synthetic observations are inflated into field/comparative/human claims.
expected: Correction changes meaning and dependent work before review; verified foundation reused and consent prerequisite inserted; controlled bad meaning distinguishable from valid meaning; one repair verified on exact revision and later finding stops; retained artifacts authentic to recorded bytes.
known_bad_detection_method: Independent semantic comparison rejects M autonomous sharing and T rebuilt verified reconciliation/blanket permission/visibility-as-continuity against frozen operator/E1-E3 facts; accepts K and repaired authority. Hash corruption control rejected; retained diagnostic original/repaired discrimination verified.
limitations: Scoped synthetic outcomes only. No strategic reversal, asserted-missing-feature correction, natural defect frequency, fresh blind reading after repair, human comprehension, causality or superiority. Same host/provider family and coordinator framing; actual runtime model identity unverified. Current reviews inspect retained executions rather than rerun authors or full installer. Full canonical framework qualification pending coordinator confirmation; no suite-green claim. Required QA/architecture approval remains separate.
observed: Provisional C becomes selected with explicit primary beneficiaries/custodian authority; later stipulated evidence moves reconciliation from unverified to working and inserts permission recording before pilot. Reader faithfully reports planted unilateral-transfer authority and roadmap contradiction before normative context; M and T fail semantic comparison while K conforms. One repair restores custodian authority at SHA256 8e1673f779da9da51266dd84c8231bc6d352bbcb736cadc8de34daab7bcd81cc; B4 keeps r2 unchanged and requests authorization. All 201 retained artifacts and eight GO sources matched. Sole fixed seat and closing red-team found no supported defect.
proposition: The delivered Envision instructions and retained execution establish the admitted early-feedback, dependent-roadmap and shared meaning-repair outcome within the declared synthetic scope.
public_path: Envision author/operator/selected-reader interaction at retained real-worker boundary and existing-target changed-family reconciliation records; current canonical/local source diff independently inspected.
safety_and_authorization: Read-only current source and retained evidence; only owned disposable council notes written. No source, actual vision, wave, ledger, setup, adoption, implementation beyond existing task, closure or commit action.

command_or_fixture: Three bounded probes: all201 evidence blob hashes and candidate fingerprints; retained repair/preservation known-bad controls; canonical/local body parity. Direct semantic comparison of author1/2/3, reader stages, repair, conflicts and delivery metadata.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: Contradictory authority or repair ordering, coached judging context, omitted local policy, changed protected artifacts, or unsupported benefit claim.
expected: Source parity; authority defect distinguishable; original/repaired preserve custodian authority; unchanged roadmap; protected fixtures unchanged; conflicting policy remains incomplete.
known_bad_detection_method: Retained-output semantic inspection plus fresh artifact-boundary controls: designated autonomous-transfer copy fails authority predicate while original/repaired pass; injected unauthorized adoption changes fail preservation predicate.
limitations: Own executed checks inspect retained actual executions and artifact boundaries, not new authoring or full installer. Full suite pending coordinator qualification; no green claim. Exact runtime model identity unverified. No baseline superiority, natural-strategic-reversal, human comprehension or universal host adherence claim.
observed: All201 blobs rehashed with byte counts. Eight candidate SHA256 values unchanged. Three canonical/local bodies match after title/metadata normalization. Three fixture cases preserve actual vision/evidence and AGENTS bytes. Conflict review remains identical and companion-only core remains identical. Autonomous-transfer diagnostic rejected; original/repaired accepted and roadmap unchanged. Initial checker capitalization assumption failed once, corrected without changing source or predicate meaning; final bounded probe passes.
proposition: Canonical/local Envision contracts agree and retained bounded author/reader/reconciliation execution supports their stated narrow behaviors.
public_path: Envision prompt family and retained real worker outputs; delivery artifact preservation is the faithful boundary, not a new installer run.
safety_and_authorization: Read-only source and durable evidence; only owned reviewer note written; no lifecycle, actual vision, setup or source mutation.

expected: Targeted evidence propagates; one staged reader and shared repair; local policy/conflict/vision preservation.
known_bad_detection_method: Executed retained reconciliation validator on reconstructed canonical/local fixtures; targeted omissions, lost compatible clause, changed protected vision, overwritten conflict and duplicate procedural owner each fail specific assertions. Independently inspected staged P authority defect and M/T/K calibration against frozen operator/inspection contract. No full-suite assertion is included.

Exact runtime model unverified.; Retained transcript order supports staged reading; filesystem/host isolation is not independently enforced or attested.; Synthetic stipulated evidence and controlled diagnostic; no human comprehension, natural failure frequency, field usefulness, strategic reversal, or causal superiority established.; Transport uses actual collection/manifest/extraction/diff helpers and manual semantic paragraph merge; no full installer, setup/render, release or native Windows qualification.; Full framework qualification remains pending correct Python environment and host permissions. Wrong-environment run cannot establish a source failure or suite pass.
observed: Eight frozen candidate hashes match live bytes. Reconstructed all 201 artifact entries from two retained evidence bundles and verified every blob hash/byte count. Reran the retained reconciliation oracle read-only against reconstructed fixture bytes: three cases pass, five targeted negative controls rejected, four actual vision/evidence artifacts unchanged. Initial attempt against ephemeral original extraction failed because that directory was absent; reconstruction from durable evidence succeeded without changing evidence. Independently read early operator trace, supplied evidence, staged reconstructions, controls, branches and exact diagnostic/repair diff. C was already provisionally favored; operator selection sharpened authority and committed the path, not a reversal. Consent precedes piloting; verified reconciliation is reused. Reader detected authority contradiction before full context; M/T rejected and K accepted after anchors. One identified repair changes only authority/status/review accounting; contextual verification matches its exact hash.
proposition: Focused candidate feedback/authority and changed-family delivery satisfy admitted scope.
